description.text: Psychologists are divided into clinical counseling, school, industrial-organizational, and other directions. See the BLS 19-3030 US 2025 combined wage, the 2025–2035 employment projection, and each branch's task and qualification boundaries.

subject.name: Psychologists
subject.summary: Psychologists study human cognition, emotion, social processes, and behavior, and carry out assessment, intervention, or research in different branches such as clinical counseling, schools, and organizations. BLS 19-3030 is a combined occupational category; clinical and counseling, school, and industrial-organizational psychologists have different tasks, education, and licensing requirements.
